ticker_news.title: Jensen Huang Just Delivered Fantastic News for Nvidia Investors
ticker_news.description: Nvidia's new Blackwell architecture, which offers significant improvements in AI inference performance, is expected to drive continued growth for the company. Despite concerns about competition from cheaper training solutions, Nvidia's dominance in inference and the strong demand for its products suggest it is well-positioned for further success.
ticker_news.author: Adria Cimino

ticker_news.title: Why Is Everyone Talking About Nebius Stock?
ticker_news.description: Nvidia has disclosed a stake in Nebius Group, an AI data center company, which has gained investor attention. The article discusses the potential of Nebius Group and Nvidia's investment in the company.
ticker_news.author: Parkev Tatevosian, Cfa

SPY.title: Trump's Plan For Canada, Mexico, China Tariffs To Start March 4 Could Shake Stock Market
SPY.description: President Trump plans to impose tariffs on Canada, Mexico, and China starting March 4, which could impact various sectors and worry consumers due to higher costs and potential retaliatory measures.
SPY.author: Chris Katje
